_doc: Publishing settings for the site. baseUrl is empty until hosting is decided. When it is set (https, no trailing slash needed), run `npm run site:sync`: it writes canonical, og:url and og:image into every page and puts the address into robots.txt and sitemap.xml. ogImage is a path inside site/. Social platforms do not read SVG, so export assets/og.svg to assets/og.png (1200 x 630) and point ogImage at the PNG before publishing.
